candidates.title: Hyderabad: Rowdy sheeter hacked to death in permit room at Bandlaguda
candidates.excerpt: A rowdy sheeter identified as Nayeem from Yellandu was hacked to death by unidentified assailants at a wine shop permit room in Bandlaguda under Nagole Police Station limits. Police suspect old enmity and gang rivalry behind the murder.

candidates.title: Gurugram biker hit-and-run: Sia questions driver’s ‘accident’ claim, asks why he did not stop
candidates.excerpt: Sia rejected Kalyan Baisla’s claim that the crash was accidental, pointed to multiple camera angles and questioned why he did not stop after she was thrown off her bike

candidates.title: Well done Congress: KTR warns Telangana is on brink of chaos
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao accused the Congress government of pushing Telangana towards chaos following the alleged attack on his PRO and PA inside Saifabad police station. He warned that such incidents could escalate into lynching and street violence.

candidates.title: Madras High Court rejects election petition against victory of Tamil Nadu Minister Sengottaiyan
candidates.excerpt: Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan allows the TVK leader’s application to reject the election petition filed by V.B. Prabhu of AIADMK

candidates.title: Gruesome Murder in Nagole: Rowdy Sheeter Hacked to Death After Seeking Refuge in Shop
candidates.excerpt: A gruesome murder took place within the limits of Nagole Police Station after a group of unidentified persons allegedly chased and brutally attacked a man with hunting sickles and knives in Bandlaguda.

candidates.title: Woman dies after delivery at Saifabad hospital, MLA demands FIR

Her family has alleged negligence on the hospital’s part. Atiya Begum, a resident of First Lancer, Syed Nagar, had come to Vijay Marie Hospital for her delivery. candidates.title: Indian-origin woman tries to save fallen friend on New York subway track; both killed
candidates.excerpt: The tragedy, caught on an eerie video, happened early Sunday morning (local time) at a Manhattan station in the city's metro system when both friends were waiting for a train, according to police.

candidates.title: Asian Games venues and athletes unharmed by extensive flooding in Nagoya, Japan
candidates.excerpt: Hirosawa said about 400 athletes and staff who are staying in converted shipping containers — remodeled to serve as temporary housing units for the Asian Games — were briefly evacuated to higher ground during the heavy rain

candidates.title: Keralam CM discusses growth, investment opportunities with social media influencers from BRICS nations
candidates.excerpt: Discussions also covered the State’s expanding port and aviation infrastructure, as well as its pool of talent comprising world-class doctors, engineers, and IT experts

candidates.title: Iran’s IRGC says oil tanker explodes after hitting naval mines in Hormuz Strait
candidates.excerpt: The Navy of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said that a super oil tanker seeking to cross the Strait of Hormuz via the "forbidden" route south of the waterway exploded and caught fire after hitting naval mines.

candidates.title: Jharkhand CID arrests two more in recruitment exam irregularities cases
candidates.excerpt: Dilip Kumar Paswan (41) of Bihar's Jamui district was arrested in connection with alleged irregularities in the JSSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) examination-2023, he said.
